description: This Java source file defines the final class CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor, which implements the Visitor interface for processing PolicyTreeNode objects. Its purpose is to traverse a policy tree, evaluate permissions for subjects and resources, and collect the subjects affected by permission changes. The class includes nested private classes and methods for permission evaluation, focusing on subjects' granted or revoked permissions within a tree structure.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses a policy tree to determine and collect subjects affected by permission changes based on specified expected permissions.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.
